finite_requirements.requirement: Freeze exact original source and production entrypoints; inventory every production kernel/helper/wrapper, literal dtype branch, implicit promotion, output cast, mask, loop and declared launch configuration. Retain test helpers in inventory but mark them test_harness only after the checker production-call/JIT review. Top-level test invocations do not require proving Python import or RNG internals.

State a finite supported API/target dtype domain grounded in source declarations and actual canonical signature admission. For each case, classify success or first rejection. A missing Python guard does not quantify over every possible Python object. A rejected route is covered by faithful rejection, never by inventing a successful kernel; a known accepted route cannot be omitted.

For successful cases, execute every source stage and operation and prove the complete source-visible returned memory/metadata/frame, including loops, tails, masks, casts and source store gates. Source-to-model correspondence is substantively reviewed and pinned; a standalone numerical formula or source-independent protocol is insufficient. Different faithful typed interpreters are permitted.

Host composition is a finite sequence of specified Python/Torch/launch primitives: allocation metadata/freshness, exact size/stride calculations, assertions, selected configs, calls and return wiring. Primitive implementation correctness is trusted. Primitive numerical operations such as abs/max/reciprocal may be abstract or deferred numerically, but producer/consumer wiring must be proved. Do not replace launch success or final values with an unconstrained assumed result.

Make source-relevant memory/layout and integer-address admission explicit. Bind actual view bases/strides/offsets; prove or represent finite-width behavior, lane/program ownership, source races and actual masks. Under fresh disjoint output and disjoint access footprints, a finite independence argument suffices; proving CUDA allocators, MMUs, schedulers, caches and compilers is outside this standard. New safety restrictions must be named and justified, not silently presented as coverage of a larger source domain.

Every unverified numerical law or callback, including concrete software arithmetic-to-native correspondence, must be registered by exact statement/case/dtype/operation/configuration and future validation. Such conformance may be deferred. Missing fp64 operations, incorrect promotion, undefined-value-domain restrictions, omitted source stages or known false conclusions cannot be numerically deferred. An OutputDefined premise needs a documented defined-behavior domain or a faithful complementary outcome, not a promise that all inputs satisfy it.

Bind current public whole-stage execution evidence through scope_schema2, exact original_scope IDs/cases and complete dtype-domain metadata, then obtain an independent substantive root review. Keep required build/axiom/source/comparator checks separate. No blanket compiler/hardware correctness gate may be added merely because native_functional_correctness remains not_established.

Keep as-written behavior and the intended mathematical operator distinct. A source bug is not repaired by broadening metadata or numerical assumptions. Full source characterization may be recorded truthfully, but a refuted intended functional claim cannot count as verified. ReLU pid-zero-only tail behavior remains explicit even after fp64 completion.

Structural failures and per-byte access failures are explicit custom errors, not proofs of native observable errors.

Logical memory, masks, stores, frames and complete sequential program permutations are proved. runLanes computes/writes each lane in order with reads from a fixed program-entry snapshot; it does not execute or refine load-all/compute-all/store-all phases, native instruction interleavings or memory races.

VA-F64-S3: Native storage, finite addresses and memory admission. String/Nat logical regions and indexed words do not establish physical byte layout/endianness, provenance, allocation extent, native pointer admission, signed i32 pid/offset/mask arithmetic or overflow behavior.

VA-F64-S4: Wrapper, inactive-lane, errors and host composition. Output separation is an explicit selected-domain premise, not wrapper freshness or physical nonaliasing. Logical missing-input/undefined-conversion errors return no final memory and prove no native poison, traps, partial-write visibility or rollback. Native masked-load behavior, allocation/device dispatch and Python/Torch module/harness composition remain open.
